target: route-projection proxy, not independently supplied per-GPS ground truth

student_test.edge_class_namespace: trip_id:canonical_directed_original_arc_id; class union includes reference-only and prediction-only roads
student_test.categorical_log_loss_policy: Normalize binary positive probabilities within each observation; absent target receives zero mass and finite log score uses floor1e-7. This is an emission log score, not a calibration claim. Misses are included in the unconditional score.
student_test.continuity_definition: Adjacent available observation assignments are continuous iff same canonical edge OR head(previous)==tail(current); no routed connectors. Empty assignments count discontinuous. Includes observed time gaps; on downsampled CV this would not imply every intervening road was predicted.
